provenance.accent: Spinner.css .saltSpinner-gradientStop stop-color: var(--saltSpinner-gradient-color, var(--salt-sentiment-accent-background)) -> characteristics/sentiment.css --salt-sentiment-accent-background: var(--salt-palette-accent) -> palette-accent base, blue #0078CF (mode-invariant, same slot family as Button/Calendar's focus and today-marker)
provenance.byDensity: Spinner.css .saltSpinner-medium: height/width var(--salt-size-base) [diameter], --spinner-strokeWidth: var(--salt-size-bar) — both foundation tokens, same density scale as Button's control-size/Calendar's day size (20/28/36/44 and 2/4/6/8 by density, foundations/sizes.md)
provenance.small-variant: DECLARED DEFERRAL (same limitation as Button's size prop): size=small uses a DIFFERENT formula — diameter max(--salt-size-icon, 12px), stroke-width --salt-size-fixed-200 (2px, fixed, NOT density-scaled) — not resolvable by the generator's single-value-per-row model yet. size=large: diameter salt-size-base*2 (56px@medium), same stroke-width as medium. style.root.size/style.arc.stroke-width below render size=medium only.
provenance.label: Spinner.tsx aria-label default "loading" (ariaLabel prop, lowercase)
provenance.repeatAnnounce: Spinner.tsx useAriaAnnouncer: announcerInterval=5000, announcerTimeout=20000, completionAnnouncement=`finished ${ariaLabel}` — re-announces on an interval until timeout, then stops with a notice
provenance.duration: Spinner.css @keyframes spinner, .saltSpinner-spinner { animation: spinner 0.9s linear infinite } — hardcoded literal, not a var() reference to any duration foundation token

structure.track.note: no track element or token in Spinner.css

structure.gradient-trail.source: SpinnerSVG.tsx: second <circle> wrapped in a <linearGradient>, stop-opacity 1->0 across offset 15%->100%

style.arc.radius.source: Spinner.css .saltSpinner-medium .saltSpinner-arc { r: calc((var(--salt-size-base) - var(--spinner-strokeWidth)) / 2) } — same formula, our slot names

style.gradient-trail.note: same accent as the flat arc — Salt's own fallback chain resolves the gradient color to sentiment-accent-background by default

style.root.duration.source: Spinner.css: animation: spinner 0.9s linear infinite (hardcoded, not a token reference)
